rib_lock_tally_gate.speaker: Hymn
rib_lock_tally_gate.line_1: The sensing cord touches my wrist through the glove and twitches with my pulse. The toll mouth opens just wide enough for biomass or a shoulder.
rib_lock_tally_gate.line_2: The cord counts while the mouth waits. The shoulder gap is narrow, and the rib is already flexing toward shut.

observe_organ_chamber.preview: Immediate: quiet pass. Echo: pulse timing retained by transit tissue.
lines: I hold still until the counting cord finishes its last pulse.
One rib opens without tearing. The wet tally cut pulses once at the same interval as my wrist.

pay_resin_toll.preview: Immediate: biomass cost. Echo: clean toll receipt retained.
lines: I press biomass into the valve until the inner teeth stop closing.
The counting cord tightens twice. The fresh tally cut closes clean after the seam opens.

push_through_spikes.preview: Immediate: flesh cost. Echo: broken rib vibration retained.
lines: I put my shoulder into the rib before the counting cord finishes.
The seam opens unevenly. The broken edge leaves red fiber and shell dust on my sleeve.

observe_organ_chamber.queued_line: The cord keeps my pulse after the seam opens. Its last twitch matches my wrist.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: The biomass does not stay local. A receipt blister swells shut behind the wall.

push_through_spikes.queued_line: The broken rib keeps ticking after I leave.

rib_lock_larval_cradle.speaker: Hymn
rib_lock_larval_cradle.line_1: The small ferry-larva reaches the surface first. Its cartilage harness is intact, narrow, and slow.
rib_lock_larval_cradle.line_2: Larger ferries wait lower in the black fluid. Their tendon straps are wider, and the old harness cuts are already opening.

observe_organ_chamber.preview: Immediate: slower safe passage. Echo: intact harness load retained.
lines: I lower myself into the small larva's harness and keep my weight on the tendon straps.
It carries me through slowly. The loops hold, and the far seam opens without a splash.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Immediate: fast damaged passage. Echo: torn harness load retained.
lines: I drop onto the large ferries before their straps finish taking my weight.
They cross fast. Two tendon loops tear loose and stay hooked in my boot.

turn_baffle.preview: Immediate: signal muted. Echo: missing command phrase retained.
lines: I twist the wet baffle until the bell polyps stop vibrating through the fluid.
Chorus drops to static for three beats. The far seam opens on the fourth.

observe_organ_chamber.queued_line: The protected ferry-larva sinks with my weight still intact in its harness.

brace_through_red_split.queued_line: The torn harness keeps my load mark. The tendon fibers do not relax.

turn_baffle.queued_line: The muted bell polyps close on the middle of Chorus' signal.

rib_lock_clot_bypass.speaker: Hymn
rib_lock_clot_bypass.line_1: Platelet beetles are closing the broken rib from the outside inward. The lower seam is still wide enough for my shoulders.
rib_lock_clot_bypass.line_2: The lower gap is wet with shellac. Clean ridges are setting above it, and the outside face still takes blood.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Immediate: damaged shortcut. Echo: repair motion retained.
lines: I crawl under the shellac while the beetles are still setting the lower row.
The repair scrapes open across my back and leaves hot shellac in the cut.

retreat.preview: Immediate: no gain. Echo: clean repair ridges retained.
lines: I leave the shortcut alone and let the beetles finish sealing the breach.
The finished repair leaves three clean ridges across the seam, straight enough to follow.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Immediate: controlled wound. Echo: false blood mark retained.
lines: I open a shallow cut and smear it on the outside face of the repair.
The beetles turn to that blood mark first and seal it into the wrong side of the shellac.

brace_through_red_split.queued_line: The scraped repair clicks under the shellac. Repair tissue starts moving.

retreat.queued_line: The intact ridges harden in clean rows. The marks are readable now.

break_marked_pattern.queued_line: The false wound dries on the wrong face of the seam.

white_marrow_field.speaker: Hymn
white_marrow_field.line_1: Old survey cuts cross the marrow in repeating lanes. Marrow lice keep the cuts clean by eating loose warmth.
white_marrow_field.line_2: One lane matches my stride too neatly. Loose marrow shows under the cleanest cuts.

follow_marked_plates.preview: Immediate: safer marked lane. Echo: stride spacing retained.
lines: I follow the clean lane and keep my feet inside the old cuts.
The lice turn after me in a single line. Their clean edges keep the spacing of my stride.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Immediate: messier lane. Echo: dirty survey edge retained.
lines: I step across two cuts and drag my heel through the lice line.
The insects scatter and leave the lane dirty. No clean edge holds the shape of my stride.

scavenge_bones.preview: Immediate: biomass gain. Echo: warm absence retained.
lines: I pry ration marrow from the cleaned bone before the lice close over it.
The exposed cut goes cold around my hand. Lice gather at the warm absence.

follow_marked_plates.queued_line: The survey cuts keep the shape of my stride.

break_marked_pattern.queued_line: The spoiled lane breaks behind me. The cut edges do not match.

scavenge_bones.queued_line: The marrow I took leaves a warm absence. Lice gather around it.

operator_cellar.speaker: Hymn
operator_cellar.line_1: Lens amoebae pulse in the wall where operator hands used to press. The old repair sequence is still readable.
operator_cellar.line_2: Three pores remain open: one repeats the order, one is wet with sealant, and one has not touched me.

study_pool.preview: Immediate: procedure read. Echo: sequence timing retained.
lines: I watch the amoebae repeat the sequence until the order is clear.
The first two pores open before I touch them. The sequence has taken my timing.

seal_amber_wound.preview: Immediate: protective seal. Echo: sampled wound edge retained.
lines: I let the wall seal a shallow wound with warm amber tissue.
The seal holds. It also leaves a clean operator-shaped edge in my skin.

leave_mutation.preview: Immediate: procedure refused. Echo: closed pores retained.
lines: I keep my hands off the open pores and leave the sealed section closed.
The amoebae dim in sequence. Nothing samples me, and nothing answers.

study_pool.queued_line: The sequence keeps running after I stop reading.

seal_amber_wound.queued_line: The seal leaves a clean edge in my skin.

leave_mutation.queued_line: The sealed procedure stays shut behind me.

operator_cellar.speaker: Hymn
operator_cellar.line_1: A shallow vat opens beside the tool holes. Womb wasps turn in the fluid with repair larvae held under their legs.
operator_cellar.line_2: The patch larvae crowd the warm side. A strip of vat wall hangs loose beside the fluid.

seal_amber_wound.preview: Immediate: useful patch. Echo: diagnostic rim retained.
lines: The wasps press a larval patch against my side and withdraw their legs cleanly.
The patch closes fast and leaves a diagnostic rim.

study_pool.preview: Immediate: sample redirected. Echo: false compatibility retained.
lines: I cut a strip from the vat wall and let the wasps sample that instead.
The larvae accept the wall tissue. The matching pore swells around the wrong material.

retreat.preview: Immediate: no patch. Echo: denied sample retained.
lines: I close the vat lip with my boot before the wasps climb out.
The fluid settles without taking a sample.

seal_amber_wound.queued_line: The larval patch leaves a rim under the wasps' legs.

study_pool.queued_line: The false sample sinks into a wall pore.

retreat.queued_line: The closed vat settles without a sample.

scar_map_junction.speaker: Hymn
scar_map_junction.line_1: The scar map revises while I watch. Scar mites clean one quiet route while a bright route pulses with my gait.
scar_map_junction.line_2: The quiet scar is clean enough to mark. The bright scar already pulses. The blank seam has no settled edge.

mark_red_branch.preview: Immediate: quiet mark. Echo: dull route groove retained.
lines: I press my nail into the quiet route and mark it before the mites finish cleaning.
The route accepts the mark without brightening. Mites clean around the groove and leave its center dull.

proceed.preview: Immediate: fast route. Echo: bright stride pulse retained.
lines: I take the bright scar while it is already pulsing with my gait.
The junction opens fast. The scar behind me pulses at my stride interval.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Immediate: uncertain route. Echo: blank seam retained.
lines: I scrape across all three routes and scatter the scar mites into the junction wall.
The map opens a blank seam with no settled direction.

mark_red_branch.queued_line: The quiet mark pulls a route packet into the signal.

proceed.queued_line: The bright scar keeps my stride lit after I leave.

break_marked_pattern.queued_line: The blank route removes evidence. The absence is visible.

biomass_larder.speaker: Hymn
biomass_larder.line_1: The larder pockets open when I put weight on the tongue-scale. Stored ration meat waits behind thin membrane.
biomass_larder.line_2: Scale teeth fold under the larder shelf. They close on missing mass, paid mass, and empty weight in different rhythms.

harvest_eggs.preview: Immediate: biomass gain. Echo: empty ration count retained.
lines: I cut open one ration pocket and take the warm mass before the membrane reseals.
The tongue-scale closes its teeth after my hand leaves. The empty pocket keeps breathing under the shelf.

pay_resin_toll.preview: Immediate: biomass cost. Echo: clean payment pulse retained.
lines: I press biomass into the tongue-scale until the teeth flatten under it.
One ration pocket opens and closes without loss. The scale pulse stays even after my hand leaves.

retreat.preview: Immediate: no food. Echo: sealed hunger retained.
lines: I step off the scale and leave the ration pockets sealed.
The teeth fold away without closing on a count.

harvest_eggs.queued_line: The missing ration closes under the scale teeth. The count stays open.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: The paid biomass moves under the shelf. A reserve pocket begins to soften.

retreat.queued_line: The ledger stays clean. The hunger does not.

biomass_larder.speaker: Hymn
biomass_larder.line_1: A credit grub hangs under the larder shelf with a ration membrane folded around it.
biomass_larder.line_2: The grub's mouth works against the folded membrane. The food is open enough to take and closed enough to leave.

harvest_eggs.preview: Immediate: ration gain. Echo: living grub count retained.
lines: I let the grub open the ration membrane and take the meat behind it.
The grub stays alive under the shelf, working its mouth around my count.

pay_resin_toll.preview: Immediate: count settled. Echo: empty grub retained.
lines: I feed the grub until its mouth stops moving.
It drops from the shelf empty. The folded membrane lies flat over the count.

retreat.preview: Immediate: no credit. Echo: closed membrane retained.
lines: I fold the ration membrane back over the grub.
The shelf seals with the food still inside.

harvest_eggs.queued_line: The credit grub keeps chewing after the shelf seals.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: The fed grub drops empty. A reserve pocket softens behind it.

retreat.queued_line: The refused credit seals under membrane.

drowned_toll_harbor.speaker: Hymn
drowned_toll_harbor.line_1: Dock mouths open along the black fluid. Their lips sit above the waterline, dry enough to count payment.
drowned_toll_harbor.line_2: The water rises close to my cuts. The drain vent is open under the dock ribs, and the basin already smells wet.

pay_resin_toll.preview: Immediate: biomass cost. Echo: dry dock service retained.
lines: I feed the dry mouths before I step into the fluid.
Two dock ribs lower with no splash. The black water stays below my cuts.

disturb_pool.preview: Immediate: wound recovery. Echo: bright wet marker retained.
lines: I wade through and let the black fluid close over the open cuts.
The pain drops. Bright residue dries at the wound edges.

vent_red_split.preview: Immediate: drained passage. Echo: wet route scent retained.
lines: I open the red vent under the dock ribs.
The harbor drains around my legs and leaves a strong wet scent in the empty basin.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: The paid dock ribs lower without wetting my cuts. A dry service remains in the harbor line.

disturb_pool.queued_line: The black fluid dries bright in my cuts.

vent_red_split.queued_line: The drained basin holds my wet scent after the water leaves.

maintenance_rite_chapel.speaker: Hymn
maintenance_rite_chapel.line_1: Tool-rest larvae line up with drain cuts in the floor. The same posture is worn into every kneel point.
maintenance_rite_chapel.line_2: Three rests are active: one receives the order, one holds the bone edit, and one grips the displaced drain cut.

observe_organ_chamber.preview: Immediate: rite stabilized. Echo: open tool order retained.
lines: I match the kneel points and drain cuts in order.
The larvae relax their grips. The chapel records me as a usable hand.

take_mutation.preview: Immediate: body edit gained. Echo: tool-fit shape retained.
lines: I let the larvae press the edit into my bone plates.
The fit is exact and too clean. Each rest closes on the shape left in my bone.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Immediate: rite disrupted. Echo: displaced drain cut retained.
lines: I step across the kneel points and scrape one drain cut out of alignment.
The larvae snap shut on empty air and the wall calls beetles into the broken order.

observe_organ_chamber.queued_line: The completed rite leaves the tool rests open in sequence.

take_mutation.queued_line: The body edit fits too cleanly in the tool rest.

break_marked_pattern.queued_line: The broken rite leaks into the drain cuts. Beetles answer from inside the wall.

launch_bore.speaker: Hymn
launch_bore.line_1: The launch rings contract in sequence. Bell polyps repeat a clipped authorization between the rings.
launch_bore.line_2: The first contraction fires fast. The second pauses around my body. One ring is thin enough to cut.

proceed.preview: Immediate: fast launch. Echo: authority weight retained.
lines: I accept the authorization and step into the contraction sequence.
The rings fire me through the bore before the tissue finishes measuring me.

observe_organ_chamber.preview: Immediate: cleaner launch timing. Echo: ring interval retained.
lines: I hold still and let each ring close near enough to measure body timing.
The launch is slower and cleaner. The bore keeps the interval.

cut_heart_cords.preview: Immediate: bleeding shortcut. Echo: visible cut ring retained.
lines: I cut one ring before it completes the contraction.
The bore fires unevenly through the wound and leaves a red route open behind me.

proceed.queued_line: The accepted authorization leaves my weight attached to the signal.

observe_organ_chamber.queued_line: The bore keeps my interval after the rings open.

cut_heart_cords.queued_line: The cut ring bleeds after launch. The shortcut stays open and visible.

story_soft_captain_pulse_mark.speaker: Hymn
story_soft_captain_pulse_mark.line_1: Chorus, a transit cord drops from an overhead seam and pulses at my wrist interval.
story_soft_captain_pulse_mark.line_2: The cord holds the count I allowed. A nearby lock opens while the pulse is still running.

story_quartermaster_lock_receipt.speaker: Hymn
story_quartermaster_lock_receipt.line_1: Chorus, a receipt blister opens in the wall and exposes one dry passage token.
story_quartermaster_lock_receipt.line_2: The token carries the ration scent I paid into the valve. Its rim is sealed and clean.

story_hunt_forced_rib_noise.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_forced_rib_noise.line_1: Chorus, a repair-hunter enters the corridor behind the broken rib seam.
story_hunt_forced_rib_noise.line_2: The transit tissue still ticks where I forced it. The hunter turns whenever the vibration repeats.

story_soft_captain_ferry_kindness.speaker: Hymn
story_soft_captain_ferry_kindness.line_1: Chorus, a small ferry-larva surfaces from a service duct beside the route.
story_soft_captain_ferry_kindness.line_2: Its harness is intact at the load knots. It rises without splashing.

story_hunt_weight_record.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_weight_record.line_1: Chorus, a tendon snare drops from the ceiling at my load spacing.
story_hunt_weight_record.line_2: The torn ferry harnesses left the same interval. The loop tightens over the place my boot should land.

story_commandant_signal_mute.speaker: Hymn
story_commandant_signal_mute.line_1: Chorus, a route packet arrives with its middle command phrase missing.
story_commandant_signal_mute.line_2: The bell polyps I muted left a clean gap in the signal. The tissue beyond it opens without a confirming pulse.

story_pell_beetle_repair.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_beetle_repair.line_1: Chorus, survey mites have copied the beetle repair into a route tag.
story_pell_beetle_repair.line_2: The ridges I left intact match the copied tag. A marked seam opens along the repair line.

story_hunt_false_wound.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_false_wound.line_1: Chorus, the repair-hunter stops at the false wound pattern and bites the wrong seam.
story_hunt_false_wound.line_2: The blood I planted holds its jaw in the shellac. The real seam stays closed behind me.

ending_soft_captain_transit.speaker: Hymn
ending_soft_captain_transit.line_1: Chorus, the lock opens before my boot reaches the pressure pad. The pulse cord starts at my wrist interval, the ferry harness lowers, and the toll valve stays shut.
ending_soft_captain_transit.line_2: No route packet names this sequence. The transit tissue runs on counts I left behind.

story_pell_survey_cuts.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_survey_cuts.line_1: Chorus, a cold survey packet opens under the marrow cuts.
story_pell_survey_cuts.line_2: The cuts I obeyed align under my boots. The open floor is rougher on both sides of the lane.

story_silt_procedure_answer.speaker: Hymn
story_silt_procedure_answer.line_1: Chorus, a diagnostic answer opens in the operator wall.
story_silt_procedure_answer.line_2: The lens sequence is still running. The exposed tissue is wet enough to read and wet enough to sample.

story_commandant_missing_checksum.speaker: Hymn
story_commandant_missing_checksum.line_1: Chorus, a route packet arrives with no checksum.
story_commandant_missing_checksum.line_2: The quiet mark sits inside the packet. The route beyond it opens fast, with no confirming pulse.

story_quartermaster_teeth_count.speaker: Hymn
story_quartermaster_teeth_count.line_1: Chorus, a tooth-count opens under my left hand and shows the ration mass I took.
story_quartermaster_teeth_count.line_2: The empty pocket still breathes inside the count. Each tooth closes on the shape of absence.

story_lumen_wet_marker.speaker: Hymn
story_lumen_wet_marker.line_1: Chorus, the black water dries bright in my cuts.
story_lumen_wet_marker.line_2: The healed edge is readable. Wet tissue brightens when I turn toward it.

story_mother_chancel_open_tools.speaker: Hymn
story_mother_chancel_open_tools.line_1: Chorus, tool rests open around the bone edit I accepted.
story_mother_chancel_open_tools.line_2: The edit fits each socket without adjustment. The rests close before I finish moving.

story_launch_authority_reply.speaker: Hymn
story_launch_authority_reply.line_1: Chorus, a launch authorization returns with my weight attached.
story_launch_authority_reply.line_2: The first packet kept its number. This one is warm under my fingers and already contracting.

story_pell_spoiled_lane.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_spoiled_lane.line_1: Chorus, a cold lane breaks before it reaches my boots.
story_pell_spoiled_lane.line_2: The survey field is still readable, but the lice cannot keep one path clean long enough to hold my step.

story_marrow_lice_hunger.speaker: Hymn
story_marrow_lice_hunger.line_1: Chorus, marrow lice gather on the warm side of this bone seam.
story_marrow_lice_hunger.line_2: They follow the warm absence left by the ration I took. The bone around it has gone cold.

story_silt_sample_edge.speaker: Hymn
story_silt_sample_edge.line_1: Chorus, another operator wall opens a pore at the exact edge of my sealed wound.
story_silt_sample_edge.line_2: The procedure tissue measures the fit against the clean rim in my skin.

story_operator_sealed_refusal.speaker: Hymn
story_operator_sealed_refusal.line_1: Chorus, another cellar keeps its first two pores sealed.
story_operator_sealed_refusal.line_2: The closed pores give less information and take no sample. The third pore opens blind.

story_operator_false_compatibility.speaker: Hymn
story_operator_false_compatibility.line_1: Chorus, a procedure wall opens compatibility pores for tissue I did not give it.
story_operator_false_compatibility.line_2: The false wall sample has a matching pore. Repair fluid gathers around the wrong material.

story_hunt_bright_scar.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_bright_scar.line_1: Chorus, a bright scar appears before the mites finish cleaning this junction.
story_hunt_bright_scar.line_2: The route opens fast. Its pulse already matches my stride, and the same brightness remains behind me.

story_glass_apostle_blank_route.speaker: Hymn
story_glass_apostle_blank_route.line_1: Chorus, this scar map has one blank route with no gait pulse.
story_glass_apostle_blank_route.line_2: Scar mites stop at its edge and clean around it. The blank tissue stays dull.

story_quartermaster_clean_payment.speaker: Hymn
story_quartermaster_clean_payment.line_1: Chorus, a larder tongue opens one pocket without closing its teeth.
story_quartermaster_clean_payment.line_2: The payment pulse is even under the shelf. The pocket opens clean and dry.

story_merchant_hunger_open.speaker: Hymn
story_merchant_hunger_open.line_1: Chorus, a sealed ration pocket opens before I touch the scale.
story_merchant_hunger_open.line_2: The membrane is already pulled back. The open edge is wet where hunger should press it.

story_larder_closed_credit.speaker: Hymn
story_larder_closed_credit.line_1: Chorus, a credit grub is sealed under its membrane and does not open when I pass.
story_larder_closed_credit.line_2: The membrane stays closed over the grub. No teeth lift from the shelf.

story_harbor_paid_dock.speaker: Hymn
story_harbor_paid_dock.line_1: Chorus, a dock mouth lowers two ribs before the black fluid reaches my cuts.
story_harbor_paid_dock.line_2: The payment rim is clean. The dock ribs stay dry above my wounds.

story_harbor_drained_scent.speaker: Hymn
story_harbor_drained_scent.line_1: Chorus, this harbor basin is already low, and the mud carries my wet scent.
story_harbor_drained_scent.line_2: The drained passage is open. The route trace stays printed in the mud.

story_rite_clean_sequence.speaker: Hymn
story_rite_clean_sequence.line_1: Chorus, a rite chamber has its drain cuts open in the order I used.
story_rite_clean_sequence.line_2: The cuts hold that sequence. A tool rest opens at hand height.

story_rite_beetle_repair.speaker: Hymn
story_rite_beetle_repair.line_1: Chorus, platelet beetles seal a broken drain cut in this rite chamber.
story_rite_beetle_repair.line_2: The displaced cut will not carry fluid. The beetles close it from both ends.

story_launch_measured_interval.speaker: Hymn
story_launch_measured_interval.line_1: Chorus, this launch bore contracts at the interval I gave the last one.
story_launch_measured_interval.line_2: The ring measure matches my recorded pause. The tissue tightens before I step in.

story_launch_bleeding_shortcut.speaker: Hymn
story_launch_bleeding_shortcut.line_1: Chorus, a red shortcut opens beside the launch rings.
story_launch_bleeding_shortcut.line_2: The wound is visible from the main route. Fluid gathers at the cut edge.

ending_pell_white_route.speaker: Hymn
ending_pell_white_route.line_1: Chorus, the white lanes have stopped branching. Each cold cut gives the same safe step.
ending_pell_white_route.line_2: The survey record is complete. My next step fits the cut before I take it.

ending_operator_component.speaker: Hymn
ending_operator_component.line_1: Chorus, the procedure cellars now open before my hands reach them.
ending_operator_component.line_2: The sampled rims match my skin. Each pore opens at hand height before I reach it.

ending_opened_hunt_route.speaker: Hymn
ending_opened_hunt_route.line_1: Chorus, every scar route brightens before I choose.
ending_opened_hunt_route.line_2: The map lights a clean step before I move. Scar mites stop working and leave the bright path open.

ending_merchant_debt.speaker: Hymn
ending_merchant_debt.line_1: Chorus, the larder opens all ration pockets before I touch the scale.
ending_merchant_debt.line_2: The food is already counted against me. No trader-mouth opens. Every pocket breathes with the same open count.

ending_lumen_wet_claim.speaker: Hymn
ending_lumen_wet_claim.line_1: Chorus, the harbor fluid rises to the height of every healed cut.
ending_lumen_wet_claim.line_2: The wet organs read the healed edges and route me by the same mark.

ending_mother_chancel_tool.speaker: Hymn
ending_mother_chancel_tool.line_1: Chorus, the rite chamber opens its tool rests around my body before I kneel.
ending_mother_chancel_tool.line_2: Tool rests close on the shape already cut into me.

ending_commandant_launch.speaker: Hymn
ending_commandant_launch.line_1: Chorus, the launch rings contract on command before I enter the bore.
ending_commandant_launch.line_2: The command phrase repeats from every ring. No local pore opens to inspect me.
